name: Chester Township Summer Recreation Day Camp
street_address: Black River Middle School, 133 North Road
description_short: Township day camp at Black River Middle School in Chester for children entering grades 1 to 6. Groups rotate through gym, art, music and games, swim three days a week at the Chester Area Pool, take a bus field trip every Wednesday and have a visiting show on Mondays.

fees.name: Before care
fees.note: Per child per hour, any time 7:30 to 9 a.m.

fees.name: After care
fees.note: Per child per hour, any time 3 to 6 p.m.

refund_policy_summary: A nonrefundable $50 deposit per child per session is due at registration. No refunds for cancellations after registration closes or for days missed; a $50 late fee applies if final payment is late.
notes: Resident rates (Chester Township and Borough): Week 1 $350, Weeks 2 to 6 $465 a week. Nonresidents pay a nonresident fee that the page does not print, and register two weeks after residents (March 25 versus March 11 in 2026). Camp runs 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Children bring lunch. The township's financial help is by contact with the Recreation Director.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 season, June 29 to August 7. Grades 1 to 6 as of fall 2026; ages derived from grades, not stated. Before and after care $15 per child per hour. Session prices left blank because only resident rates are printed. 'If you need financial help' contact the Recreation Director.
